title: 第370章 从今日起，立志做一个伟大的帝王
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

盛世女人万两金，乱世女人一斗米的说法，刘盈在很早以前就已经听过。

甚至于，在这身体的记忆里边，他也见过了太多这样的例子。

但是，真正听说这种不可思议的发生在自己身边的时候，他心里还是有一万个卧槽的。

“去里边瞧瞧，寡人倒是很好奇，谷蠡单于说他身边有一个大祭司，这个人似乎很不一般。”

审平立刻道：“殿下稍后，臣这就去传唤大祭司前来，但是殿下不可直接进入匈奴军营之中去。”

“这有什么不能去的？”刘盈并不在意，自己在匈奴人之中，杀名强到可怕，谁还敢在这个时候，对自己动手不成？

“为求安全考虑，殿下一人，身系天下千千万万人的身价性命！”

审平没有任何退步的可能。

刘盈闻言，也只好道：“寡人在那边的山坡上等着他，你让人去传唤他过来。”

“喏！”

审平松了一口气，但是他心中多少有些不快，觉得安澜这个时候，就不应该当做自己什么都没看到一样。

至少，应该站出来劝说一下殿下才是。

刘盈驱马一顿飞驰，片刻时间后就到了山坡上。

随行的人立刻就铺好了地毯，摆上矮几酒水。

这种就像是变戏法一样的操作，让刘盈看得有些喜欢起来靠山的规矩了。

臧儿站在山头上，迎着迎面吹来的风，大声喊叫着，但是却没有回音。

目力所及的地方，之在天地尽头。

或许，也就是因为这个原因，草原上的人，都不会是那种心胸狭窄之辈。

走出帐篷，看到的就是辽阔无尽头的天与地。

这个时候，刘盈看到了昨天的那个三个女人，正在这边放牧。

她们手里拿着鞭子，嘴里在大声唱着一种刘盈听不懂的歌谣。

但是，这个时候只要是有眼睛的人，都能看得出来，她们现在非常快活。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Liu Ying had heard the saying a long time ago that a woman in prosperous times was worth ten thousand taels of gold and a woman in troubled times was worth a dou of rice.

Even in this body's memory, he has seen too many such examples.

However, when he actually heard that this incredible thing happened around him, he still felt a million sh*t in his heart.

"Go and have a look inside. I am very curious. Gu Li Shanyu said that there is a high priest beside him. This person seems to be very unusual."

Shen Ping immediately said: "Your Highness, I will summon the high priest in a moment, but Your Highness is not allowed to enter the Huns camp directly."

"What's not to go here?" Liu Ying didn't care. Among the Huns, he had a terrible reputation for killing. Who would dare to do something to him at this time?

"For safety reasons, His Highness is responsible for the lives of thousands of people in the world!"

There is no possibility of regression in the trial.

When Liu Ying heard this, she had no choice but to say: "I am waiting for him on the hillside over there. You have someone go and summon him."

"Here!"

Shen Ping breathed a sigh of relief, but he felt a little unhappy in his heart. He felt that An Lan should not pretend that he saw nothing at this time.

At least, he should stand up and persuade His Highness.

Liu Ying drove her horse at a gallop and reached the hillside in a moment.

The people accompanying him immediately laid out the carpet and set out some drinks.

This kind of magic-like operation made Liu Ying like the rules of the patron.

Zang'er stood on the top of the mountain, facing the oncoming wind, shouting loudly, but there was no reply.

As far as the eye can see, it is at the end of heaven and earth.

Perhaps, for this reason, people on the grassland are not that narrow-minded.

Stepping out of the tent, all you see is the vast and endless sky and earth.

At this time, Liu Ying saw the three women from yesterday, grazing here.

They held whips in their hands and sang a song loudly that Liu Ying could not understand.

However, anyone with eyes can see that they are very happy now.
